source_of_truth: static audit of models/director_treatment.py, core/director_treatment.py, api/director_treatment_api.py, api/scene_blocking_api.py, api/shot_plan_api.py, api/storyboard_materializer_api.py, core/production_policy.py, core/decision_packet.py and existing tests

must_block_when: scene identity or ScriptIR lineage is stale
payload or authority envelope is invalid

storyboard_materializer_indirect.authority_note: Materializer consumes approved ShotPlan; Treatment must be validated upstream and is not a creative shot generator.

production_lookup_baseline.current_behavior: latest approved row by scene_name in SceneBlocking/ShotPlan and no explicit current Treatment pointer
production_lookup_baseline.required_behavior: scene_id -> current authoritative Treatment pointer; no fallback in production

blocking_gaps: scene_id is absent from DirectorTreatment schema and consumers primarily join on scene_name
production evidence uses Script.content sha256 instead of ScriptIR authority envelope lineage
client source_script_revision can influence production evidence
approved Treatment has no immutable authority envelope or payload tamper check
no explicit current scene Treatment pointer
approved and production-qualified semantics are conflated
contract_rule: Only fields observed by SceneBlocking/ShotPlan consumers are downstream-blocking; unresolved asset identity/geometry/prop requirements remain backlog and are not silently converted into source facts.
